name: Spice Cycle
laws: Spice is produced by sandworms in arid desert
Spice is required for Guild navigation, Bene Gesserit prescience, extended life
Desert preservation preserves spice preserves Imperium
costs: Arrakis must remain desert; terraforming it destroys the cycle
limits: Spice is a finite yield per unit desert
Attempts to synthesize spice (Tleilaxu) are imperfect
examples: Dune — Paul's rise controls the spice
God Emperor of Dune — Leto II's ecological intervention

name: Prescience Trap
laws: Seeing multiple futures narrows the choosable set
The oracle's capacity is their captivity
costs: Self becomes subordinate to the vision
Jihad becomes inevitable because it is already seen
limits: Cannot see past another prescient (mutual blindness)
Cannot see past a self-correcting decision (the Golden Path)
examples: Dune Messiah — Paul's Jihad he cannot stop

name: Religion as Political Technology
laws: Prophecies can be planted generations in advance
The Bene Gesserit Missionaria Protectiva plants myths
costs: Once planted, the myth cannot be fully controlled
The tools (belief) reshape the user over generations
limits: Cannot override genuine charisma that exceeds the plant
